VERVE Ozeki Rack

$5,699 AUD
Available In Stock
Shipping
Australia Wide
14 Day
Money-Back
Description

Stop juggling multiple machines and wasting space. The VERVE Ozeki Rack brings a complete functional trainer, lat pulldown, low row, and commercial grade power rack together in one unit, so you can train the way you want without compromise. Named after the grand champion rank in Japanese Sumo, the Ozeki is built for those who refuse to settle for anything less.

Features

  • Complete Functional Trainer with 2 x 105kg weight stacks, giving you full cable versatility without needing a separate machine
  • Commercial grade 75 x 75 x 3mm steel uprights with laser cut numbering and Westside hole spacing, so you can set up quickly and trust every rep
  • Built-in lat pulldown with premium hard chrome bar included, ready to use without rearranging your setup
  • Built-in low row with premium hard chrome bar included, so you never have to skip back training
  • Pull-up bar with five different hand positions to match your grip preference and training goals
  • Leg roller and upright support for secure, stable lat pulldowns every time
  • 2x sandwich J-hooks included for all your barbell movements straight out of the box
  • Enough internal space to squat, bench, and press inside the rack with confidence
  • Compatible with the full range of VERVE rack attachments, so your setup grows with you

Built for serious training.
Scroll To Continue ↓
01 /04
505+ Exercises, One Machine

We did the maths. 505 exercises, all from a single piece of equipment. Cables, lat pulldown, low row, power rack, and five-grip pull-up bar mean you will never outgrow this machine. Whether you are chasing strength, hypertrophy, or rehab work, the Ozeki keeps up with wherever your training takes you.

Make It Yours

Your training is unique, and your setup should be too. The Ozeki is compatible with a wide range of VERVE rack attachments, so you can add dip attachments, landmine posts, and more as your goals evolve. No dead-end purchases, just a rack that adapts to you.

Move Between Exercises Without Breaking Stride

Tired of spending half your session rearranging equipment? The Ozeki lets you go from lat pulldowns to low rows to cable work at the D-handles without touching a single attachment. Less time setting up means more time actually training.

Commercial Grade Construction

When you are loading serious weight, you need to trust what is underneath you. The Ozeki's 75mm x 75mm uprights are made from 3mm thick commercial grade steel with a double powder coated VERVE finish that resists chips and wear. Laser cut numbering and Westside hole spacing make setup fast and repeatable, so you spend less time adjusting and more time lifting.

Dual 105kg Weight Stacks

Two independent 105kg weight stacks give you the resistance range to cover everything from light rehab and warm-up sets to heavy cable work. No pin changes between sides, no waiting, just smooth, consistent resistance whenever you need it.

Lat Pulldown, Always Ready

A dedicated lat pulldown station is built right into the Ozeki with a premium hard chrome bar included. No more swapping cables or repositioning pulleys before every back session. Sit down, grab the bar, and get to work.

Low Row Built In

The Ozeki's integrated low row features steel foot plates for a solid brace, a cable angle engineered for smooth resistance through the full range of motion, and a premium hard chrome bar included. It feels like a standalone machine because it is built like one.

Fully Adjustable D-Handles

Dual D-handles at the front of the rack adjust up and down the full height of the uprights, giving you the freedom to hit chest flyes, face pulls, tricep pushdowns, and everything in between. One adjustment point, hundreds of exercise options.

Unmatched Power Rack Functionality

Most functional trainers sacrifice rack space to fit weight stacks. The Ozeki does the opposite. With both weight stacks positioned at the rear, you get genuine internal lifting space for squats, bench press, and overhead work. Load a barbell, set your J-hooks, and train inside or outside the rack with full confidence.
